Describe an event recode for display to the user

Source: R/utils-eventindicator.R
dot-describeEventIndicator.Rd

Turns the result of .defineEventIndicator() into the HTML disclosure block shown by every analysis that builds an event indicator. A silent recode is a clinical-safety hazard: the reader of a survival curve cannot otherwise see which levels were collapsed into "censored".

Usage

.describeEventIndicator(res, outcome_name = "outcome")

Arguments

res

The list returned by .defineEventIndicator().

outcome_name

Display name of the outcome variable.

Value

A character string of HTML.
